headline: Q2FY27 Update

highlights: The company achieved an AUM addition of INR 37,680 crore during the quarter.
The year-on-year volume growth is not directly comparable because the festive season started earlier last year.
On the profitability front, the company reported a consolidated Profit After Tax (PAT) of INR 6,367 crore, a 29% increase over Q2 FY26.
Profit Before Tax (PBT) also rose 29% to INR 8,537 crore, and PBT before the prudent management and macro-economic provision grew 34% to INR 8,874 crore.
